definitions.explanation: Having or appearing to have length, width, and depth. Used in science, technology, and everyday language.
In otaku culture, refers to the real world and real people, as opposed to the two-dimensional world of anime, manga, and games.

notes:
USAGE:
In technical contexts, refers to 3D space or 3D technology. In internet and otaku culture, {三次元|さんじげん} (3D, real world) contrasts with ⟦{二次元|にじげん}→二次元：11422_nijigen⟧ (2D, anime/manga world). This slang usage is widely understood in Japan.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {三次元|さんじげん}⟦プリンター→プリンター：04416_purintaa⟧ (3D printer)
- {三次元|さんじげん}⟦{映像|えいぞう}→映像：04444_eizou⟧ (3D imagery)
- {三次元|さんじげん}CG (3D computer graphics)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{二次元|にじげん}→二次元：11422_nijigen⟧: two-dimensional, 2D — also used for the anime/manga world
- ⟦{立体|りったい}→立体：18797_rittai⟧: solid, three-dimensional — more formal/technical synonym
